description: Progress indicators show the status of a process in real time.

tags.devx: - `value` is clamped to 0–100; indeterminate variants ignore it.
tags.a11y:
- Renders `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`; determinate
  variants also expose `aria-valuenow`.
- Provide `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`; this component does not infer an
  accessible name.
tags.limitations: - Visibility auto-hides at 100% (no controlled open prop).

className.name: className
className.description: Root classes (string), static element classes (object), or state-aware element classes (function).

value.name: value
value.description: The percentage of the progress completed.

transitionDuration.name: transitionDuration
transitionDuration.description: The duration of the transition animation in milliseconds.

minHeight.name: minHeight
minHeight.description: The minimum height of the line used to draw the linear indicator.
